notes: No precedent for Serax in this project (first Belgian DTC site). Shopify storefront (serax.com canonical, www redirects to bare domain). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (generic Shopify agent-guidance block only, plus a UCP/MCP notice) - direct fetch worked for every page, no WAF bypass needed. Access route: direct fetch + Shopify /collections/<handle>/products.json paged (limit=250) with unique product-ID dedup for exhaustive counts (Rule 1) - collection products_count field proved inflated on every collection checked (e.g. dinnerware reported 1514 vs 1305 exact, glassware 203 vs 184, mirrors 17 vs 14, spotlights not reported at all in the master total). Category tree built from the site's own mega-nav (Tableware, Lighting, Home accessories, Furniture) plus targeted discovery of unlinked-but-real Shopify collections found via /collections.json when nav coverage looked incomplete. Furniture branch (tables/chairs/stools/sofas/shelves/outdoor furniture) fully excluded per brief. Dinnerware Sets dropped as a facet re-cut: /collections/dinnerware-sets is a 48/48 exact ID subset of /collections/dinnerware (same products, bundled-set view), not additive. Rule 0.2 lighting deep-traverse: /collections/lighting (183 exact) sits below its 4 nav-linked children (table/wall/floor/pendant lamps) plus two off-nav but real, distinct sibling collections discovered via /collections.json - Spotlights (/collections/spotlights, ceiling spot/track fixtures, 0 overlap with the 4 nav children) and Desk/Work Lamps (/collections/desk-lamps, 1 product) - and the 6 children sum EXACTLY to the 183-product Lighting master with zero overlap, confirming full coverage. Mixed-rollup collections were title-inspected per 'drop the out-of-scope portion, don't pad' and the in-scope subset counted exactly (not estimated): Candle & Tealight Holders (103 on page, 51 titled 'Scented candle...' excluded as Home Fragrance, 52 genuine holders/wind-lights remain); Bathroom Accessories (18 on page, 10 excluded as storage/fixtures [8 lidded boxes + 2 soap dispensers], 8 genuinely decorative Cose-brand trays remain, kept per Rule 0.4); Kitchen & Table Accessories (93 on page, 29 excluded as functional kitchen/bar tools [egg cups, cutting boards, kitchen utensil sets, bottle opener, wine cooler, salad servers, spoons, ice buckets, chain trivets, coasters, napkin rings, lids], 64 decorative serving items remain [trays, cake stands, bowls, platters, baskets, serving stands/dishes] - documented overlap per Rule 0.6: ~34 of these 64 IDs also appear in the separate Trays & Serving Platters listing below, both kept since each is a real distinct site collection). Trays & Serving Platters (/collections/trays, 49 exact) is a real but nav-unlinked Shopify collection, title-clean (trays/platters/serving dishes, minor 5-item noise of vase/plate/lid cross-tags left in as reported by the site). Decorative Objects includes 4 'Josephine' glass flower items explicitly marketed as 'individual glass flowers... a delicate alternative to fresh flowers' - counted as decorative glass sculptural objects, not artificial/faux plants (no plastic/silk foliage on this site was found). Mirrors, Vases, Pottery & Planters, Glassware, Dinnerware all title-clean with zero cross-category ID overlap (verified). All qty values are exact unique-product-ID counts via exhaustive /collections/<handle>/products.json pagination, not the (inflated) products_count field.
